item.title: Attorney General Ellison, Ramsey County Attorney Choi win agreements and injunctions to prevent gang violence at the State Fair
item.description:
Publication Date: August 20, 2026

In AG Ellison’s and RCA Choi’s August 5 civil lawsuits against two gangs, 7 of 10 people named in their lawsuits agree not to attend Fair or be present in Safety Zone around Fair
